discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 of B021 (DLP 2017); reuses keys from 227_b021, 435_b099, 472_b286; no other packet has dlp/2017 keys. 30 WebSearch calls, standard mode, blocked domains passed; all search_snippet. Released holds: Christmas 4-pin members (472/435), ornament pairs (435), princess couples (472), ducks+Elena (435). New: Rapunzel three, SotF booster size, BatB booster members, Star Tours LE 1000, July pins, Goofy CM pin. dein-dlrp Mar/May/Jun/Jul/Sep/Nov still teaser or missing; passiondlp Q2/Q4 not indexed. Jan month: 8 new pins, 1 booster, 1 lanyard, only one LE (dein-dlrp).
